title: Topic 20: Animals & Nature - Speaking

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
LESSON SPEAKING TASK):
Record a 60-second monologue: AN ANIMAL I KNOW.
A pet, a family member's pet, or an animal you see
every day.
Cover:
1. Who: I have... / My sister has... + its name
(my dog's name is... - T3 's!)
2. What it looks like: big/small + colours (T4 + T18)
3. What it CAN do and CAN'T do
4. Its day: what it does every day + what it is doing
right now, if you can see it! (T7 + T17)
